case_scope: Two frozen performance inputs; not navigation accuracy or general deployment throughput

probes.scope: Separate attribution probes. Real layer0 fused projection weights versus the same dequantized FP16 matrix; hot isolated matrices do not represent full-model cache/memory traffic. No model weights or serving configs changed.
probes.profiler_limit: CUPTI initialization failed in WSL; CUDA kernel activity trace unavailable. CUDA events and HTTP timers remain measured; do not infer activation bandwidth saturation from these probes.

limitations: Fixed 2/9 images,701/2815 prompt tokens,64 generated tokens; greedy output IDs may differ. Batch1 eager3072, no prefix/KV quant/token pruning.
CUDA event intervals include GPU idle/host dispatch gaps; stream decode includes scheduler/sampling/detokenization. Instrumented diagnostics are not a replacement for original closed-loop timings.
Audited mode preserves original stage2 adapter; native mode bypasses only diagnostic validation/hooks/logging using native forward and metadata; separate ablation.

Every measured 64-token response has one prefill plus 64 observed decode forwards (65 total), including one extra backend forward. Event interval means include all 64 actual decode forwards; stream average is over 63 returned-token gaps. Separate profiler requests can have more asynchronous lookahead and are excluded. Initial exporter assumed 64 total and was corrected offline without rerunning any requests.
CUPTI_ERROR_NOT_INITIALIZED in WSL: no valid GPU kernel activity trace. CUDA event timers succeeded. Activation memory bandwidth saturation was not measured.
Native audit-ablation has only one model-order block; all full-adapter comparisons have forward/reverse blocks.
Frontend-to-worker gap is measured across processes on the same monotonic clock, but serialization, transport, engine preparation, scheduling and H2D portions have not been individually separated.
Single hot projection microbenchmarks do not predict full-model decode memory traffic. CPU preprocessor ablation ran separately after model service shutdown.

failures.reason: Synthetic text warmup consumed image request plan; fixed before any measured requests.

Initial 64-forward assumption rejected actual 65-forward measurements; corrected count accounting offline, preserved all original requests and failure log. Profiler-only requests have more lookahead and remain excluded.
